page.notes: The page opens mid-sentence, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The heading "AV LECTEVR." is set in small capitals; I have written it in capitals as printed. The scan shows faint show-through text near the bottom, which is left out. The reading "fe" in the first line is the long-s form of "se", written as "se". Words rendered with long s (s) are written with a plain s, as required. Where the printed u and v and i and j forms differ from modern usage, they are normalised: vn to un, Iuge to Juge, auec to avec, deuoir to devoir, arriue to arrive.
